title: Bonnie Raitt songs and the Mighty Diamonds
summary: He recalls songs Bonnie Raitt recorded and says Wardell Quezergue worked with the Mighty Diamonds.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: Did you write Good Enough for Bonnie Raitt specifically? On her home plate album, the song Good Enough? Yeah. So you'd written that before she picked it up?
I don't know the song Good Enough.
Don't dare hum it. We'll go on to something easier.
Well, I know one of the things she did was, uh, What Do You Want to Do?
You covered that. And she also, I think she did What a Success at some point.

I don't remember Good Enough. It's a, it's a kind of a fast, it's a really funky song. It's a real bouncy. It's a real bouncy. Right. Get back to that. Okay. Uh. How do you, how do you like working with the Mighty Diamonds?
I didn't have to go in with them myself, actually. Ward El-Gazare went, went in with the Mighty Diamonds. So actually, I just saw them around. Mm-hmm. I didn't have to actually work with them.
